Aql

Private AI inside your organisation — in Arabic.

Aql is a private-AI platform that runs entirely inside your premises — modern language models, document search, and natural-language data queries, with your data never leaving the building.

Discover Aql

Key Features

Full Privacy

All processing on your hardware. No internet egress required, no data sent externally.

Arabic-Native

Qwen 2.5, Llama 3.3, and Jais — paired with a fully localised Open WebUI.

Document Search (RAG)

Retrieval-augmented generation over your firm's contracts, regulations, and cases, with cited sources.

Natural-Language Queries

Ask your databases questions in Arabic; Aql translates them into safe, permission-scoped SQL.

Compliant by Design

Architecture aligned with PDPL and NDMO from day one — data never leaves the Kingdom or the office.
